newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on select buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on select buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks gained on Thursday on select buying of blue chips, but dealers said the overall sentiment was mixed as genuine investors kept to the sidelines owing to weak domestic economic indicators.

"Blue chips, including PTCL, Hub Power and ICI Pakistan, gained on fresh buying as the levels were attractive," dealer Ali Asghar said. "It seems the market has bottomed out," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "But the rise will be restricted as major investors are still not sure about the potential upside."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 13.41 points, or 0.85 percent, to end at 1,582.28.
Losers led gainers 150 to 142. Turnover fell to 40.83 million shares from 49.98 million on Wednesday.
Dewan Salman Fibre rose to 0.45 rupees to 38.30, Hub Power 0.60 to 37.55, PTCL 1.0 to 30.20 and ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 22.55.
